_comment: Every command registered in exactly ONE shell, with the reason it is one-sided. verify-shell-registration.py fails on a one-shell command with no entry here, and on an entry whose command both shells now register. This is the same statement verify-ipc-parity.py's per-shell sections make from the other direction (a command the UI calls that a shell lacks); it exists because parity cannot see a command nobody calls yet. Add an entry when you intentionally register in one shell only; delete it when you register in both.
